# Modern Rubber Products

> > Industrial rubber and elastomer materials supplier specializing in EPDM, Nitrile, Neoprene, Viton®, and PTFE sheets with custom molding services.

Modern Rubber Products, based in Chattanooga, provides commercial-grade rubber sheets, gaskets, and custom injection molding services for industrial applications. They offer NSF-61 certified materials for waterworks and chemical-resistant solutions for processing industries.

## Key Topics

- EPDM Rubber
- Nitrile (NBR)
- Neoprene
- Viton® (FKM)
- Shore A Durometer
- Gasket Materials
- Oil-Resistant Rubber
- Weather-Resistant Materials
- Chemical-Resistant Seals
- NSF-61 Certification
- PTFE/Teflon Sheets
- Urethane/Polyurethane
- Commercial-Grade Rubber
- Custom Injection Molding
